item.title: Many hazards along right of way from the rear of Cedar Road, Brockworth. Several man hole vovers sticking up and road has exposed metal mesh road to degrading.very unsafe, 1st September
item.description:
The right of way has been re-routed in at the rear of Cedar Road. The right of way is extremely bumpy and and overgrown. Several branching rights of way pathways have been blocked by thick brambles since before Easter time. The right of way leads the walker to the bypass. Several trip hazards from 3 large man hole covers, which resident tripped over and injured knee. Lots of building materials pollute the brook. The right of way terminates on busy Church Lane and has no junction or crossing to warn motorists of pedestrians. This once was a beautiful area.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Perrybrook Road, Coopers Edge, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
